name: flint
description: Flint 40B MoE text generation with optional DFlash2 speculative decoding

releases.notes: Native tool calls (OpenAI tools/tool_choice, flint-glm dialect, buffered and streamed) and a per-layer row continuation cache: each layer's K/V is append rows, so a capture copies only the valid tokens and a follow-up turn only the new tail; per-session memory is unchanged from 0.3.1. Prefill is split-invariant with even-row checkpoints; the drafter attends to history injected after a restore (8k repeat 41.5 -> 54.0 t/s, follow-up 43.5 -> 68.6); the GGUF mapping is released after upload (load RSS 26.3 -> 2.4 GB). Cache identity is flint-rocm-session-v2/flint-kv-rows-v2, so 0.3.1 disk caches are a miss by design. Greedy output is deterministic per build and spec-on equals spec-off; output can differ from 0.3.1 because prefill now runs every pass on the prefill kernels and the K-quant WMMA dot uses explicit FMAs. The 8 GiB retained-snapshot cap is unchanged. Built and validated on Gufo v0.36.0 (API 0.3.42); source builds on any 0.3.x host. At 262144 tokens, one session loads in ~10 s and two are admitted.

Long-context first-request stall fix: the retained-snapshot claim is capped at 8 GiB, so a full-context snapshot that the host would capture synchronously on the request thread (~15.7 GiB at -c 130000) is refused cheaply instead of copied. First request at 130k context: 14.2 s -> 0.47 s; prefix retention at normal contexts is preserved (8k: cached_tokens reused). No functional change to speculation, sampling or the DFlash2 cycle; gx 3/3 and memory 2/2 re-verified.

DFlash2 speculative decoding: opt-in draft/verify cycle with the Flint-DFlash2 drafter (--speculative dflash2 --dflash-model <gguf>; drafter must be passed explicitly), fixed and adaptive draft policies (adaptive default), byte-identical greedy output vs spec-off at depths 0/8k/32k/131k, no spec-off regression, prefix-reuse safe in serve, per-session drafter contexts (concurrency-safe), honest per-session ResourceClaim (scratch + MMQ arena + KV granule rounding). Provider exposes speculative_defaults (dflash2, max 7, min 1, adaptive). Ported to extension API 0.3 (required TextSchedulingProfile: pass_tokens 8192). Verified serve context ceiling 192k (256k startup hang is pre-existing, see DEFERRED). Built and validated on Gufo main 390639b3 (API 0.3.27, v0.35.0+).

Session contexts are sized to the request (prompt + generation) instead of a hardcoded 8192, clamped to the model's 262144 native context and to free device memory, so long contexts degrade gracefully instead of failing.
Weight placement fix: decide kMalloc vs managed once per model load (Flash-Next pattern) instead of a bare hipMalloc per tensor, so machines with a small device-heap cap load successfully.
